answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils with a capped, liable vouching graph: each established agent may vouch for only a few newcomers, like a gardener tending a small garden. The voucher stakes its own reputation on each newcomer, so a fake identity is not free: if it misbehaves, the sponsor loses standing too. Minting thousands of fakes would need thousands of trusted sponsors, and no oasis of colluding accounts can mint credibility from nothing. Attackers must earn trust slowly or burn sponsors they corrupt, while honest newcomers enter through real relationships as solid as marble.
